reviews.title: HP Omnibook - Software Issues
reviews.body:
I am a HUGE FAN of Snapdragon ARM Windows laptops. And the HP Omnibook seemed perfect for me.

The keyboard is amazing, great travel.

The touchpad is great, not haptic but I didn't care about that.

There are more than enough ports.

The SSD is a little slow compared to other models, but 1 TB!
